title: Neighbours on 45th Street; being Number One but unemployed
summary: Everyone around him used drugs while he was out of work.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Like, Miles and all the guys used to come by my pad. I used to live on 45th Street, and in fact, everybody and his brother came by and said, "Hey, Maggie, can I use your bathroom?" I said, "Well, yeah..."

Yeah, they was into it at that time, yeah. Like, Walter Bolden lived in the same building, and Bennie Green lived in the same building and he was strung out, and if he didn't have nothing, I had some, and if I had some, he'd... So I mean, it was kind of a hard thing to keep away from, with everybody living right in that vicinity and

Yeah. And at that time, I had been voted, I think, the Number One Trumpet Player in America, and I was layin' up here in New York just lookin' for the gig, doin' nothin'! So that was one thing that kind of...
